title: Marketplace manifest (yg-marketplace.yaml)
description: Marketplace manifest (yg-marketplace/1) — the packages a marketplace repository publishes. Read from <marketplace root>/yg-marketplace.yaml. A key not listed is ignored by this reader (the /1 rule), so additionalProperties is true.

packages.description: The packages this marketplace publishes (an empty list is legal).

name.description: The package name, one path segment, unique in the marketplace.

path.description: The package directory, relative to the marketplace root.
